products.title: Symbiosis Project x Bambito Estate Gesha Washed
products.body_html:
Producer: Priscilla Gonzalez & Hunter Tedman

Origin: Bambito, Chiriqui, Panama

Elevation: 1800 masl

Variety: Gesha

Process: Washed

Dongze's Notes: Jasmine, Mango, Longan

Hunter Tedman (of Blackmoon Farm) started a new collaborative project called Symbiosis Coffee back in 2024. The team works in partnership with smaller coffee producers from the Boquete area, sources coffees from those producers, and brings them back to Blackmoon Farm to do the processing. This results in coffees that are elevated to both retain the origin terroir and emphasize their characteristics via the meticulous processing.

Bambito Estate has been one of our long running favorites. While the new crop directly from farm is still on the way, I found this special collaboration lot between Bambito and Blackmoon to be especially interesting - as it brings out something complex that I haven't fully tasted in the traditional Bambito farm processed washed Geshas.

products.title: Blackmoon Chiroso Anaerobic Natural Lot 0206
products.body_html:
Producer: Hunter Tedman

Origin: Alto Quiel, Boquete, Panama

Elevation: 1700 masl

Variety: Chiroso

Process: Anaerobic Natural

Dongze's Notes: Muscat Grape, Plum, Berries

As a comparison to the more traditional Colombian washed Chiroso, we sourced a Panamanian natural processed Chiroso, the varietal and process with which Hunter Tedman and Blackmoon Farm won the 2024 Best of Panama varietals category. Chiroso betrays it’s Ethiopian roots here with a unique aromatic profile, while the tropical fruit notes are enhanced by the process, almost reminiscent of fresh ripe coffee fruit.

products.title: 2026 Finca Sophia Auction Tasting Set (RW2 + HN11)
products.body_html:
This year (2026), Panamanian coffees have faced a drastic decline in production due to weather reasons. Therefore, many of the farms only produce coffees in nano lots ranging from the quantity of sub-1kg (as small as just 300 grams) to just tens of kgs. Sampling becomes a luxury because one batch of sample roast could very well use up an entire lot.

Therefore, to better preserve and celebrate the rarity, Finca Sophia, one of the award-winning high-elevation boutique farms, reserved all of its coffee production for its own private auction. And I'm glad that I was able to secure just a tiny amount (500g each) of two amazing coffees from the auction.


Reserve Washed 2 (auction page)

Origin: Lot Colibri & Lot Poro, Finca Sophia, Nueva Suiza, Tierras Altas, Chiriqui, Panama

Elevation: 2026-2094 masl

Auction Price: $3770/kg

Dongze's notes: Intense Jasmine Florals, Citrus, Bergamot


Auction notes:

Harvested under ideal conditions, this selection yielded one of the larger washed lots of the season, ultimately producing 9 kilograms of green coffee. We applied the same slow, raised-bed drying protocol used on several of our standout washed coffees, allowing the coffee to dry gradually over an extended period.

The effect was striking: enhanced floral aromatics, a creamy and refined texture, and exceptional balance throughout the cup. Elegant yet expressive, this coffee became the second lot to earn placement within the Grand Reserve Collection, a testament to the quality potential of these beloved sectors and the patience required to bring it fully to life.

 

Heritage Natural 11 (auction page)

Origin: Finca Sophia, Nueva Suiza, Tierras Altas, Chiriqui, Panama

Elevation: 2026-2130 masl

Auction Price: $3110/kg

Dongze's notes: Purple Flowers, Hawthorn / Yang Mei, Muscat Grape


Auction notes:

This lot is one of a remarkable trio harvested on April 23 from the highest elevations of Finca Sophia. The three lots originated from the same areas and were picked on the same day, but were separated according to cherry maturity into Red Cherry, Pink Cherry, and Black Cherry selections, offering a rare opportunity to explore the influence of ripeness on cup character.

As the least ripe of the three selections, the Pink Cherry lot presents the freshest expression of the series. Bright and transparent, it combines lively acidity with surprising depth, revealing subtle dried fruit notes alongside its vibrant fruit character.

Like the Black Cherry selection, this coffee spent 11 days drying on raised beds before conditioning in the dark room for an additional 9 days. The result is a coffee of remarkable sweetness, clarity, and elegance that highlights both the influence of ripeness and the precision of the drying process.
